SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.name,
    p.flow,
    SUM(ds.units_sold) as total_units_sold,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) as total_revenue,
    AVG(ds.units_sold) as avg_daily_units,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.date) as days_sold,
    ib.book_on_hand_close as current_stock
FROM store.daily_sales ds
JOIN store.products p ON ds.sku = p.sku
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book ib ON ib.sku = p.sku AND ib.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.inventory_book)
WHERE ds.date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, p.flow, ib.book_on_hand_close
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC;

WITH double_charge_bills AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bill_id, complaint_ts
    FROM payments.customer_complaints
    WHERE complaint_ts >= '2026-06-01'
      AND complaint_ts < '2026-07-01'
      AND kind = 'charged twice'
),
subsequent_visits AS (
    SELECT dcb.bill_id as original_bill, dcb.complaint_ts,
           pl.bill_id as subsequent_bill, pl.bill_ts
    FROM double_charge_bills dcb
    JOIN store.pos_lines pl ON pl.bill_ts > dcb.complaint_ts
    WHERE pl.bill_id != dcb.bill_id
)
SELECT original_bill, complaint_ts, COUNT(DISTINCT subsequent_bill) as return_visits,
       MIN(subsequent_bill) as first_return_bill, MIN(bill_ts) as first_return_ts
FROM subsequent_visits
GROUP BY original_bill, complaint_ts
ORDER BY original_bill;
